card_sentences: SAMPLE Rosalind's grandchildren bake her chickpea cracker recipe in a Brooklyn bakery that opened in 2019. They started the company to get the crackers out of the holiday tin and into lunch breaks.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE Contains: wheat, milk, eggs, soy, sesame, peanuts and tree nuts (almonds, cashews, hazelnuts, pecans, pistachios, walnuts). Also contains fish (anchovy) and crustacean shellfish (shrimp, crab).
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE May contain mustard. Made on shared equipment that also processes other tree nuts, oats and celery.
